releaseNotes:
1. Fixed Infinite Reload Loop & Blank Screen: Relocated private browser profile to Windows LocalAppData and added comprehensive watcher ignore rules to eliminate Edge CacheStorage reload loop.
2. Service Worker Dev Mode Disabled: Prevented local ServiceWorker from writing redundant cache files to disk.
3. Robust Browser Relaunch on Update: Added graceful termination for running POS windows before applying files to prevent hanging blank states.
4. Defensively formatted live Scale weight readout in header.
